title: Gregg Lemkau - The Evolution of MSD (Capital Allocators, EP.291)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Gregg Lemkau is the CEO of MSD Partners, the investment firm with roots as Michael Dell's family office.
reader_summary.overview: Gregg Lemkau is the CEO of MSD Partners, the investment firm with roots as Michael Dell's family office. MSD was formed in 1998 to manage $400 million of Michael's capital. In the ensuing twenty-five years, that initial $400 million has grown to north of $20 billion.

key_points.text: Gregg joined MSD two years ago after a twenty-eight-year career at Goldman Sachs, where he rose to Co-Head of Investment Banking.
Our conversation covers Gregg's career path at Goldman and lessons learned.
We discuss his decision to join MSD, the firm's history, objectives, competitive advantages, and investment capabilities.
